notes: Stripe webhook payloads follow the standard Event object structure with id, type, created, data.object, livemode, and pending_webhooks fields.
The charge.refunded event indicates a full or partial refund of a charge associated with a subscription invoice.
Verify webhook signatures using the Stripe webhook signing secret (whsec_*) via HMAC-SHA256 with timestamp validation to prevent replay attacks.
The connector should extract charge.id from data.object.id and customer email from data.object.customer (requiring a separate Customer lookup if email is needed).
For local testing, use the Stripe CLI to forward events to localhost; production requires a publicly accessible HTTPS endpoint.
Endpoint retrieves all tags for a subscriber identified by subscriber_hash (MD5 of lowercase email).
Requires list_id and subscriber_hash as path parameters.
Response includes tags array with objects containing id, name, and status.
Pagination is not mentioned in the docs; assumes all tags returned in a single response.
Used to check if a tag already exists before adding to avoid duplicates.
Endpoint adds or removes tags from a list member; creates new tag if it doesn't exist and status is 'active'.
Requires list_id and subscriber_hash as path parameters.
Request body expects tags array of objects with name and status fields.
Idempotency-Key header is supported; use Stripe charge.id as the Idempotency-Key value to prevent duplicate tag additions.
If the tag already exists with status 'active', the connector should skip the POST call (determined via prior GET).
Empty response on success; no meaningful response body to parse.
Authentication via Bearer token using Mailchimp API key.
